mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.code FROM t_permission p INNER JOIN t_role_permission rp ON rp.permission_id = p.id INNER JOIN t_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rp.role_id INNER JOIN t_role r ON r.id = rp.role_id WHERE p.delete_at = 0 AND p.status = 1 AND r.delete_at = 0 AND r.status = 1 AND ur.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT DISTINCT p.code FROM t_permission p INNER JOIN t_role_permission rp ON rp.permission_id = p.id INNER JOIN t_role r ON r.id = rp.role_id WHERE p.delete_at = 0 AND p.status = 1 AND r.delete_at = 0 AND r.status = 1 AND rp.role_id IN
#{roleId}

WITH RECURSIVE ancestors AS ( SELECT id, parent_id FROM t_permission WHERE id = #{permissionId} AND delete_at = 0 UNION ALL SELECT p.id, p.parent_id FROM t_permission p INNER JOIN ancestors a ON p.id = a.parent_id WHERE p.delete_at = 0 ) SELECT id FROM ancestors

WITH RECURSIVE descendants AS ( SELECT id, parent_id FROM t_permission WHERE id = #{permissionId} AND delete_at = 0 UNION ALL SELECT p.id, p.parent_id FROM t_permission p INNER JOIN descendants d ON p.parent_id = d.id WHERE p.delete_at = 0 ) SELECT id FROM descendants
SELECT id, code, name, parent_id, status, create_time, update_time FROM t_permission WHERE delete_at = 0 AND status = 1 ORDER BY create_time ASC
